caption: The drawing depicts a rural scene with a group of people and several animals in a green pasture, under a sky divided between dark storm clouds on the left and lighter clouds on the right with rays of sunlight coming through. In the foreground and middle ground, there are two large stacks of green hay loaded on wooden carts with red wheels, each pulled by teams of brown and white oxen. Several people, dressed in blue and white clothing, are tending to the hay: three are standing near one cart, with two holding long tools, while two others are perched on top of the haystack on the right cart. Another person is guiding an ox team in the left foreground. More oxen and hay carts are visible in the left middle ground, with additional figures working. The background features a wooden split-rail fence running horizontally, a large tree with dark green foliage partly beneath the storm clouds, and dense dark green vegetation. The ground is mostly green grass with a few haystacks scattered around. At the bottom right, orange text reads “IT WILL SOON BE HERE, PC.”
title: It Will Soon be Here
